title: ChessBet
tagline: A website that allows users to bet on live chess games.
description: Chess Bet is a platform for chess lovers powered by blockchain. Do you think you can analyze the moves and predict the winning side? Chessbet is the perfect website for you to bet on the side of your choice and make a fortune while enjoying the game!! Every game is governed by our smart contract which is an autonomous piece of software running on the Polygon blockchain. Our goal is to ensure the security of your funds while you can safely and securely place bets and earn money in a decentralized, peer-to-peer manner with no central company involved.
how_its_made:
Client - Angular, Web3.js 

Server - Node.js, Heroku, MongoDB

Blockchain - Solidity, Polygon
